name: com.unityobu.security
description: Build-time and runtime hardening for Unity Android IL2CPP apps. String encryption, encrypted asset bundles, a build pipeline gate that enforces IL2CPP stripping, and best-effort anti-debug / anti-tamper runtime checks. Raises the bar against dumping and asset ripping; it does not make them impossible.

samples.description: Drop-in bootstrap prefab and sample scene that runs the runtime checks on startup.
